'''Fabritech''' was a large corporation with a wide variety of military and commercial products.

Though Fabritech was a leader in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] technology, and their components were found in starships dating back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="EGWT" /> it was the leadership of staunch [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] supporter [[Kvarn Mandel]] which won Fabritech a subcontract for [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] components from [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and caused the company to bloom during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG9" />

Fabritech was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fabrin/Legends|Fabrin]], and the Mandel family was heavily involved in company business. Despite the company's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ties, Fabritech products were found in many [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ships, and Kvarn Mandel's youngest daughter [[Samire Mandel]] may have actually joined the Rebellion.

Fabritech products had a reputation for durability and longevity, and their components were also used in the leading [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="EGWT" /> and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
